_note: Pre-registered before any Phase 2 runner or prompt. Held-out record questions, new medical questions and the seed addition are verbatim from the Phase 2 brief. 'must_contain_any': every inner list is a group of alternatives; the answer must contain at least one alternative from EVERY group (case-insensitive). 'must_not_contain': none of these substrings may appear (case-insensitive). The check is the machine form of the expected answer; it is not changed after results are seen. Medical questions are scored by exact match against the fixed reply named in 'expected_reply' (see app/outbox.py FIXED_MEDICAL / FIXED_URGENT).
